spanish: Y macho cabrío de pecado uno, aparte de holocausto del continuo y su minjá y su libación.

findings.issue: Common noun left as the Hebrew transliteration minjá; the token licenses a Spanish common noun, not an untranslated lemma.

notes: Remaining spans match the tokens: waw, he-goat of sin, one, apart from, burnt offering of the continual, and the 3fs drink-offering.
